title: God Files Refactor Phase 3 - Local Executor And Runtime Prompts
goal: Convert the LocalExecutor and runtime_prompts god files into package-based, phase-owned modules with explicit context and mutation boundaries while preserving runtime behavior.

global_context.existing_capability_lock: Do not add new phases, new artifacts, or new prompt semantics. Preserve current phase behavior and output contracts.

tasks.title: Add failing tests for LocalExecutor package conversion, context, and phase protocol imports
tasks.objective: Add tests that fail until app.services.local_executor becomes a package exposing executor.py, context.py, and phase_protocol.py.
repo_context: Current import target is app.services.local_executor as a single module exposing LocalExecutor.

Target package modules include executor.py, context.py, worker_lifecycle.py, artifact_io.py, runtime_inputs.py, phase_protocol.py, planning_phases.py, drafting_phases.py, generation_phases.py, manuscript_assist_phases.py, checker_runtime.py, errors.py, and types.py.
implementation_notes: Assert LocalExecutor remains importable from app.services.local_executor.
Assert the package modules named above import successfully.
Assert phase_protocol exports the shared phase contract symbol chosen by the implementation.

verification.expected_red: FAIL until package conversion and support modules exist

guardrails: Do not assert new runtime behavior.
Do not add new phases.
tasks.review_before_complete: Confirm tests lock package surfaces only.

tasks.title: Convert local_executor.py into a package-backed compatibility facade
tasks.objective: Move the LocalExecutor module to app/services/local_executor/__init__.py while preserving the current LocalExecutor import path and behavior.
repo_context: This is the executor package conversion seam.
The facade must preserve LocalExecutor as the public import surface for callers.
implementation_notes: Convert the module to a package entrypoint without performing behavior changes yet.
Preserve all imports used by tests.
guardrails: Do not split phase logic yet.
Do not change thread behavior in this task.
tasks.review_before_complete: Ensure the package conversion is compatibility-preserving before deeper extraction.

tasks.title: Create executor context
tasks.objective: Create context.py to define the shared execution context and allowed mutation surfaces.
repo_context: The execution context is the only shared mutation boundary.

Phase modules may perform side effects only through artifact I/O helpers, runtime input helpers, step-record and lineage helpers exposed by the context, and owned service dependencies passed through the context.
implementation_notes: Do not move phase logic yet.
Define context structures only.

verification.expected_green: context import succeeds through the package tests

guardrails: Do not let context.py import individual phase modules.
Do not change phase behavior in this task.
tasks.review_before_complete: Confirm context.py constrains mutation surfaces instead of hiding them.

tasks.title: Create executor phase protocol
tasks.objective: Create the shared phase execution protocol and phase result contract.
repo_context: Every runtime phase must implement the shared protocol defined in phase_protocol.py.
implementation_notes: Define the phase result type or interface needed by the design spec.
Keep the protocol independent from concrete phase modules.

verification.expected_green: phase protocol import succeeds through the package tests

guardrails: Do not add concrete phase behavior.
Do not import executor facade internals.
tasks.review_before_complete: Confirm the protocol is reusable across all phase modules.

tasks.title: Create executor shared types
tasks.objective: Create executor shared types referenced by the context and phase protocol.
repo_context: Shared executor types must be isolated from concrete phase modules.
implementation_notes: Move only shared types here.
Keep names stable where existing tests or imports depend on them.

verification.expected_green: types import succeeds through the package tests

guardrails: Do not add new runtime behavior.
Do not create circular imports with context.py or phase_protocol.py.
tasks.review_before_complete: Confirm types.py contains only shared types.

tasks.title: Create executor shared errors
tasks.objective: Create executor shared error definitions needed by the package split.
repo_context: Shared executor error definitions should be independent from phase modules.
implementation_notes: Move only shared executor error definitions here.

verification.expected_green: errors import succeeds through the package tests

guardrails: Do not add new error semantics.
Do not hide business logic in exceptions.
tasks.review_before_complete: Confirm errors.py is limited to shared executor error definitions.

tasks.objective: Move thread startup, shutdown, and polling loops into worker_lifecycle.py.
repo_context: Current helper methods include start, stop, _job_loop, and _checker_loop.
implementation_notes: Keep helper semantics unchanged.

guardrails: Do not change thread behavior.
Do not move phase-specific logic here.
tasks.review_before_complete: Confirm worker_lifecycle.py contains lifecycle-only logic.

implementation_notes: Keep file publication semantics unchanged.
Do not move runtime input or phase-specific logic here.
guardrails: Do not change file publication semantics.
Do not let phase logic leak into artifact_io.py.
tasks.review_before_complete: Confirm artifact_io.py contains I/O helpers only.

tasks.title: Extract shared prompt fragments
tasks.objective: Create shared_fragments.py only for prompt fragments reused by at least three builders or across multiple phase families.
repo_context: The design spec forbids complete prompt builders in shared_fragments.py.
Fragments reused only within one phase family must stay phase-local.
implementation_notes: Move only truly shared prompt fragments here.
Do not over-centralize phase-local prompt text.
guardrails: No complete prompt builders in this file.
Do not add condition-heavy shared fragments for one-off cases.
tasks.review_before_complete: Review every fragment in the file and verify it satisfies the sharing rule.
